description.text: The maximum student number of a class 15, they form a group to practice Chinese. There are various course for the students with different Chinese level. Applicants could take the course which is suitable for yourself. Beginner: Intensive Reading, Chinese Listening, Spoken Chinese, Chinese Characters Elementary: Intensive Reading, Extensive Reading, Spoken Chinese, Chinese Listening, Introduction to Chinese Culture Intermediate: Intensive Reading, Extensive Reading, Newspapers-and-journals Reading, News Listening, Introduction to Chinese History Advanced: Intensive Reading, Extensive Reading, Newspapers-and-journals Reading, Practical Chinese Writing, Translation, Chinese Linguistics Features of Chinese language program 1) Classroom teaching: Two kinds of classes(mass class or one-to-one class)are offered. You can attend either one according to their levels of Chinese proficiency and their own wishes. 2) After-class assistance with Chinese learning: A Chinese tutor is available for any international student. 3) Flexible entry time: Each year has two chance of entry and registration in February and September respectively, or prompt entry upon the arrival of the international students at any time of the year.

duration.text: The Long-term Chinese Training Program at Hubei University is a 1 Year long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1944 USD/In total ￥ 14000 CNY/In total

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant.

requirements.text: 1.Applicants must be in good health 2.Applicants must be age of 16 or above
